name: chika-idol-calendar
description: 複数の地下アイドルの予定をまとめて確認するカレンダーアプリ

scripts.terraform:check: terraform fmt -check -recursive infra && terraform -chdir=infra/environments/staging init -backend=false && terraform -chdir=infra/environments/staging validate && terraform -chdir=infra/environments/production init -backend=false && terraform -chdir=infra/environments/production validate
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run types:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run deploy:dry-run:staging && npm run deploy:dry-run:production && npm run terraform:check
